style: Photorealistic interior photograph of a staged, unoccupied apartment, eye-level wide-angle view from the room's entrance, even daylight, plain matte walls, light wooden floor with clear open walking space in the middle, a standard white interior door (about 2 m tall) fully visible on one wall. No people, no pets, no text, no logos, no artwork with faces.

images.living_room: Living room: a three-seat fabric sofa against the left wall, a low coffee table in front of it, and a small wooden two-drawer side cabinet about 60 cm tall standing alone near the right wall.
images.bedroom: Bedroom: a double bed against the back wall, a small bedside nightstand next to it, and a light wooden chest of drawers about 70 cm tall standing alone near the right wall.
images.study: Home office: a desk with a chair against the back wall, and a small wooden bookshelf cabinet about 80 cm tall standing alone on the floor near the left wall.
images.living_room_light: Small living room: an armchair against the left wall, a low TV bench against the back wall, and a slim hollow light wooden pedestal stand about 30 cm square and 90 cm tall (empty, nothing on it) standing alone on the floor near the right wall.
images.living_room_pedestal: Small living room: an armchair against the left wall, a low TV bench against the back wall, and one tall, narrow, closed box-shaped display pedestal with solid light-wood panels on all sides (a plinth about 30 cm wide, 30 cm deep and 90 cm tall, flat empty top, no legs, no openings) standing alone on the floor near the right wall.
images.living_room_cabinet: Living room: a three-seat fabric sofa against the left wall, and one tall closed wooden storage cabinet (about 80 cm wide, 60 cm deep and 100 cm tall, flat top, two plain solid doors, no legs) standing alone on the floor in the middle of the room, its doors facing the camera, with at least 1.5 m of empty floor behind it and in front of it.
images.living_room_bookcase: Living room: a three-seat fabric sofa against the left wall, and one tall, shallow, closed wooden bookcase cabinet (about 80 cm wide, 30 cm deep and 100 cm tall, flat top, closed back, two plain solid doors, no legs) standing alone on the floor in the middle of the room, its doors facing the camera, with at least 1.5 m of empty floor all around it.
images.living_room_trio: Small living room: an armchair against the left wall, a low TV bench against the back wall, and three identical tall, narrow, closed box-shaped display pedestals with solid light-wood panels on all sides (each a plinth about 30 cm wide, 30 cm deep and 90 cm tall, flat empty top, no legs, no openings) standing on the floor in a loose row near the right wall, about 80 cm apart, with open floor around each.

living_room_pedestal_three.prompt: Edit this photo: add exactly two copies of the tall light-wood pedestal that stands by the right wall. Each copy must be as tall as that pedestal (its top level with the existing pedestal's top, clearly higher than the armchair's armrest), narrow and upright: about 30 cm wide, 30 cm deep and 90 cm tall, a closed box with a flat empty top, no legs, no openings, the same wood. Place both against the left wall in front of the armchair (between the armchair and the camera), standing in a row along the left wall about 70 cm apart. Keep the middle of the floor completely empty. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the room, walls, floor, armchair, TV bench, TV, door, the existing pedestal, the camera view and the lighting. Add nothing else. No people, no text.

scope: Self-generated home interiors for the image-to-scene pipeline (no real homes, people or retrieved photos): each shows furniture obstacles, one candidate piece to move and a standard door as the scale reference. living_room_light and living_room_pedestal hold a slim, light pedestal shaped like the simulated carry proxy (0.30 x 0.28 x 0.90 m, 2-4 kg) for the lift-and-carry tier, and living_room_trio holds three of them for a multi-item move; the other rooms' pieces are expected to be heavy. Muse Image sets only the aspect ratio from size. Edits change a generated image by an instruction (no mask); living_room_pedestal_three is the pedestal room with two more identical pedestals, for a multi-item move in the same room.
